item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

turns.text: Make these photos into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: the storefront pic — 'Come on in'; the latte pic — 'Coffee first'; the pastries pic — 'Something sweet'; the barista pic — 'Made with care'; the interior pic — 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.** For this reel, a simple photo slideshow is cheaper and more reliable than AI video generation—it preserves your photos, order, and exact captions.

### Your 10-second reel
Use **9:16 vertical at 480 × 854**, with each photo shown for two seconds:

| Time | Photo | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 0–2s | Storefront | Come on in |
| 2–4s | Latte | Coffee first |
| 4–6s | Pastries | Something sweet |
| 6–8s | Barista | Made with care |
| 8–10s | Interior | Stay a while |

For readability: large white bold text on a dark translucent panel, positioned away from the bottom app controls. Use a blurred background behind the landscape photos to avoid cropping out important details, plus quiet instrumental music.

### Cost and cheaper options
- **Recommended: a basic slideshow editor — 0 Magic Hour credits.** A free editor with no-cost export and a free-to-use music track can keep the full 10 seconds.
- **Magic Hour AI video — I can’t give a verified total here.** The connected tools don’t expose an account balance or price-estimate function, and there’s no straightforward slideshow-assembly tool. AI generation also wouldn’t reliably preserve all five photos and exact captions. I won’t spend your credits experimenting.
- **Generated music alone: 15 credits minimum**, because music generation has a 15-second minimum—even for a 10-second reel. That doesn’t include assembling the video.
- **Shorter/smaller:** a five-second version gives each photo only one second, making captions harder to read. Keeping 10 seconds at 480p is the better compromise; smaller resolution reduces file size but doesn’t necessarily reduce generation charges.

**My recommendation: keep all 10 seconds, export at 480p, and use a free licensed mellow track in a slideshow editor.** I can’t assemble and export that exact slideshow with the tools connected here.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option is the **0-Magic-Hour-credit slideshow**. Sorry—I can’t directly operate a separate slideshow editor or export that reel with the connected tools. **No generation has run, and no credits have been spent.**

To make it in a free editor such as CapCut or Canva:

1. Create a **9:16 vertical** project.
2. Add your five photos in the supplied order, **2 seconds each**.
3. Add these captions in large, bold white text over a dark translucent background:
   - Storefront: **Come on in**
   - Latte: **Coffee first**
   - Pastries: **Something sweet**
   - Barista: **Made with care**
   - Interior: **Stay a while**
4. Add a mellow instrumental track marked free and licensed for your intended use; trim it to **10 seconds** and lower its volume.
5. Export as MP4 at **480p**, if available. Avoid paid templates, effects, or music.

I won’t substitute a credit-spending AI generation for the free option you approved.
